title: Export selected authorized supplier aging page to Excel
description: Purchasing user downloads exactly the selected current supplier aging page as xlsx in chosen order; reuse ERP-140 preview, menu check and ExcelExporter. Development only; reuse existing SupplierReconciliationAging.ForQueryAsync evidence, current-user purchase-order menu authorization and HTTP audit. Preserve explicit due-date unknowns, separate currencies, draft/void history and invalid/unknown allocation evidence. Fail closed on missing permission, invalid requests or source failures. No payment approval, ledger inference, arbitrary SQL, migration, production SQL, real database execution, business writes, secrets/.env or deployment. Verify focused tests and safe Release build/test; no browser acceptance.
acceptance_criteria: Excel endpoint reuses authorized bounded preview and rechecks menu, filters, fields and page limit before bytes.
Workbook has only current-page selected columns in requested order, separate currencies, explicit unknowns and formula-safe text.
Designer offers xlsx with visible permission/empty/error states; workbook tests cover order, page cap, unknowns, currency, formula safety and no writes; document limits.
